messages:
emma: Heads up — hitting duplicate POST creations from the async Python SDK when a client timeout is followed by a successful server processing. Seems retries sometimes drop Idempotency-Key. Repro below.

 sahil: Oof. Is this the non-streaming POST path?

 emma: Yes. Minimal: 
```py
async with RedwoodAsyncClient(api_key=...) as c:
    await c.post('/v1/resources', json={'name': 't1'}, headers={'Idempotency-Key': 'k-1'}, retry=RetryConfig(max_attempts=3))
```
Client logs a timeout, then retry succeeds and server created a second resource.

 luis: I think it's from the transport refactor — streaming bodies get turned into aiohttp payloads and the retry code reuses the request object; header generation was attached to the original lifecycle and not copied. So replay ends up missing the header.

 emma: Log excerpt: 
```
client: POST /v1/resources id_key=k-1 -> timeout after 10s
client: retry attempt=1 -> resending request (no Idempotency-Key)
server: 200 Created r_100
client: retry succeeded -> returned 201 r_101
```

 sahil: Fixes: (1) snapshot headers on first send and reuse for retries; (2) make bodies rewindable/buffer small payloads; (3) default behavior: don't retry POSTs unless Idempotency-Key present or user opts in.

 dana: Also note typing DX — RetryConfig/BackoffStrategy types aren't exported from top-level package, causing mypy friction. We should re-export types in __init__.py.

 luis: I'll implement: attach request._retry_meta.headers = shallow_copy(headers) and on retry rebuild outbound headers from that snapshot. For body: buffer up to 1MB for retries; mark streams >1MB as non-retriable unless Idempotency-Key present.

 emma: I'll add a pytest-asyncio integration test and a tiny examples/repro script for support. Pseudo: 
```py
@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_retry_keeps_idempotency(async_client):
    async_client.stub.delay_response(11, 200)
    await async_client.post('/v1/resources', json={'x':1}, headers={'Idempotency-Key':'abc'}, retry=RetryConfig(max_attempts=2))
    assert async_client.server.request_count(header='Idempotency-Key') == 2
```

 ci-bot: opening CI build for pr/transport/retry-headers (luis)

 luis: PR up: https://github.com/redwood/inference-sdk/pull/1241 — WIP with header snapshot + buffer. Adding changelog.

 emma: Verified locally on the branch: idempotency key preserved across attempts and duplicates stopped in my repro. Will run full suite. :thumbsup:

 sahil: After merge, update quickstart to show async idempotency example and call out streaming caveat. Also export BackoffStrategy typing at package level.

 dana: Will draft the hotfix note for 0.18.1 if CI looks clean.
